To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cost effectiveness of a universal Hib conjugate vaccine program depends on whether intangible benefits of the program are included in the cost benefit analysis.
the cost benefit analysis of the Hib vaccination program in a low incidence country like Thailand is highly dependent on intangible benefits, which should be included in future CBA studies.
the universal conjugate Hib vaccine program is cost effective if intangible costs and benefit are incorporated in the cost benefit analysis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the incorporation of intangible benefits in the CBA of a universal Hib conjugate vaccination program in Thailand and its impact on the economic evaluation of the program.
the incorporation of intangible benefits into CBA.
the development and application of methods for the incorporation of private demand into the cost benefit analysis of health programs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the universal Hib vaccination program is cost effective if intangible benefits of preventing deaths, disability, and disease are included.
the Hib conjugate vaccine is cost effective and should be included in the national immunization program of Thailand.
, if intangible benefits were not included in the model, a universal Hib vaccination in Thailand would not be considered cost effective.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the universal Hib conjugate vaccination program is cost effective in Thailand, and the inclusion of intangible benefits is essential to the program.
a universal Hib vaccination programme is a cost effective strategy for reducing the burden of Hib disease in Thailand.
the universal Hib vaccine in Thailand is not cost-effective from the provider perspective, but it is cost-effective from the society perspective, and it is cost saving from the client perspective.
The main takeaway from our work is that
private demand should be included in the cost benefit analysis of universal Hib vaccination program.
intangible benefit is an important factor that must be incorporated into the analysis.
intangible costs and intangible benefits should be considered in CBA of vaccination programs.
